findings.title: Budget can be fully removed by the tool, contradicting the stated budget rule
findings.problem: The system prompt says a budget stays a hard limit, but the rag.search tool description loosens filters through 'the budget raised by 25%, the budget removed', so the tool can drop a stated budget.
findings.proof: A budget stays the limit when the shopper invites going over it; the reply names how to raise it.
findings.fix: Exclude price_max from the loosening order in the rag.search description, or state in the system prompt which budget relaxations are allowed and that the reply must say so.

findings.title: Role lacks a success rule for clarifying-question turns
findings.problem: The Goal and Success define the table and spoken summary, but the Planner's clarifying-question path has no matching success criterion in the role section.
findings.proof: or one clarifying question when there is no product to search for.
findings.fix: Add one line to Success stating what a clarifying-question turn must contain.

findings.title: No personalization or profiling control for a recommendation use case
findings.problem: The context has no rule limiting how recommendations use inferred or profiled attributes (for example age or interests inferred from speech or history) and no bias or steering check, which the Limited-risk recommendation use case and NIST AI RMF / ISO 42001 call for; it should live in the system prompt's Safety policy.
findings.fix: Add a Safety policy section that bars inferring sensitive attributes, limits use to the shopper's stated constraints, and requires that ranking rests only on cited evidence.

findings.title: Flagged web results are excluded only as price sources
findings.problem: A web result carrying instruction-like text is barred only from being a price source, not from the evidence the Answerer and Critic read, so its snippet can still reach the model.
findings.proof: a web result that had such text is flagged and is never a price source.
findings.fix: State that flagged results are dropped from the <evidence> and <tool_results> fences entirely, not only from price use.

findings.title: Catalog index lists referenced but not supplied
findings.problem: The knowledge file calls the brand, category, material and claim lists complete indexes, but the Router and Planner are given no such lists, so they cannot check filter names before calling rag.search.
findings.fix: Supply the brand, category, material and claim index lists in the knowledge corpus or state explicitly that unmatched_filters is the only check.

findings.title: rag.search description is much longer than its schema needs
findings.problem: The rag.search description repeats loosening order, safety-flag rules and output field lists that are already in the system prompt and the parameter descriptions, making the tool block heavy.
findings.proof: Loosening: when fewer products than `top_k` meet every filter, filters are loosened in this order until enough are found
findings.fix: Keep the when-to-call and filter rules in the schema, and remove the loosening order and output field list, leaving a pointer to the system prompt's Search section.

findings.title: Search rules duplicated between system prompt and tool schema
findings.problem: The system prompt restates the filter rules the rag.search description already gives, so the same constraints are paid for twice in every request.
findings.proof: The budget, age and brand the shopper stated are sent as filters whatever a model wrote.
findings.fix: Keep the filter rule once, in the system prompt's Search section, and cut the matching sentences from the rag.search description.

findings.title: Shortened fixed replies duplicate the full texts
findings.problem: fixed_replies.md gives every spoken sentence twice, once in full and once in a shortened form, so most of the file repeats itself.
findings.proof: Spoken before a product answer, these are shortened so that the reply still fits 15 seconds:
findings.fix: Store one text per id with a short-form field only where the wording differs, or keep only the short forms for product answers.

findings.title: Pipeline overview restates the enforced-by-code section
